claim.why_it_matters: The clause heading 4.5.4 is transcribed as a plain paragraph line with no heading marker, while its siblings 4.5.1-4.5.3 (page 498) and 4.3.4/4.4.4 (pages 491, 493) are '### ' headings; a heading-based section index or citation lookup for §1985:IX.4.5.4 (Indexed I-O READ general rules) misses it.

verdict.reasoning: The printed page (IX-29) sets '4.5.4 General Rules' at the left margin as a clause heading, in the same style as its sibling clause headings. In specs/ANSI_COBOL_1985.md the line (line 19363) is a plain paragraph, while the Indexed I-O READ siblings at lines 19313, 19317 and 19341 (4.5.1 Function, 4.5.2 General Format, 4.5.3 Syntax Rules) and 4.3.4/4.4.4 at lines 19106 and 19159 are all '### ' headings. The text itself is correct; only the heading marker is missing, so a heading-based lookup of IX 4.5.4 would miss it. The defect is structural only; the rule text is unchanged.
